people.name: Abihail
people.line: Father of Zuriel, a Levite leader

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.
translations.bsb: The leader of the families of the Merarites was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
translations.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
translations.asv: And the prince of the fathers' house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: they shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle northward.
